tooltip.computronics.pocket_terminal.des: Compact handheld data terminal with hardware 32x12 VRAM display.
Receives wireless display rendering packets via OpenComputers wireless network cards.
Right-click toggles power. Can be recharged in OpenComputers Chargers.
tooltip.computronics.entity_detector.des: High-precision directional entity and player scanner with configurable cone.
tooltip.computronics.screwdriver.desc1: Used to configure modular control panels, buttons, and lamps.
tooltip.computronics.screwdriver.desc4: Off-hand Name Tag: Apply custom text label onto the button cap.
tooltip.computronics.panel_text.desc1: Mountable custom text label for control panels with in-hand sizing.
tooltip.computronics.panel_text.desc2: Configure text string, color, scale and style via Screwdriver GUI or OpenComputers API.
tooltip.computronics.toggle_switch.desc: Latching industrial toggle switch for control panels. Click to toggle ON/OFF.
tooltip.computronics.seven_segment.desc1: Mountable multi-digit seven-segment glowing LED display for control panels.
tooltip.computronics.seven_segment.desc2: Configurable via Screwdriver GUI or OpenComputers setSegment API.
tooltip.computronics.card_fx.desc: Emits programmable particle effects around machine.
tooltip.computronics.mini_lamp.desc: Right-click to mount a miniature RGB LED onto a control panel or wall.
tooltip.computronics.mini_button.desc: Right-click to mount a tactile push button onto a control panel or wall.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_light.de: Indicator RGB LED board for OpenComputers Server Racks.
Controls 4 indicators and display modes across the rack face.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_switch.d: Tactile toggle switch board for OpenComputers Server Racks.
Right-click toggles switches and emits network signals to rack servers.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_boom.des: Remote detonation board for OpenComputers Server Racks.
Hazardous payload! Supports remote command and countdown detonation.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_capacito: High-density power buffer module for OpenComputers Server Racks.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_co_proce: Hardware cryptographic ASIC board for OpenComputers Server Racks.
Accelerates MD5, SHA-256, CRC32, and AES-128 encryption with zero cycle overhead.
tooltip.computronics.rack_board_kvm.desc: 4-port KVM routing module for OpenComputers Server Racks.
Centralizes server console focus. Switchable via click on rack face or OpenOS scripts.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.speech: Equips robots and drones with a voice synthesizer.
tooltip.computronics.network_card_3.desc: Tier 3 Ethernet Controller with 64 open ports.
Supports 64 KB Jumbo Frames for high-throughput networks.
tooltip.computronics.packet_sniffer.desc: Promiscuous TAP mode for passive traffic analysis.
Monitors PPS, bandwidth, and filters network frames.
tooltip.computronics.card_boom.desc: Detonates computer case on demand. Handle with caution!
tooltip.computronics.rf_jammer_card.desc: Mobile radio frequency jammer for computers, tablets, and robots.
Disrupts and scrambles wireless communications in a dynamic radius.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.chat: Allows robots and drones to speak in chat and whisper to players.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.radar: Equips robots and drones with a 3D entity radar.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.camera: Equips robots and drones with optical distance and raycast scanning.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.winch: Equips drones with a deployable winch cable and grabber hook.
